# Northstar Supply: synthetic sales definitions



All data and report metadata are fictional. No real customer data is included.

The platform metadata is normalized fixture content, not native validated app exports.



- Ordered value: order-line quantity multiplied by unit price; order-date basis.

  Includes orders without invoices. This is a bookings measure, not recognized revenue.

- Invoiced sales: invoice-line ExtendedPrice minus TaxAmount; invoice-date basis.

  This simplified demo calls that revenue, without claiming accounting revenue recognition.

- ExtendedPrice includes tax in the synthetic invoice dataset.

- No currencies, discounts, returns or cancellations are modeled.

- Customers and products are shared between the two reporting paths.

- A product may belong to multiple stock groups. There is no designated primary group

  or approved allocation weighting. Group totals are therefore not necessarily additive.

- A proposed daily customer/product product must specify its date basis, tax treatment

  and grain. Do not silently substitute orders for invoices or invent missing dates.

- Qlik Sales Performance uses orders. Spotfire Customer Sales uses invoices.

  Both use all loaded dates and amounts excluding tax; differing tax treatment is not

  an explanation for a difference between these particular two synthetic reports.

Synthetic customer sales report across all invoice dates. Customer identity is CUSTOMERID; customer name is a label. Sales excludes tax, invoice total includes tax. No currency is modeled.
Artifact: synthetic executable report fixture, not an actual BI dashboard.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.ANALYTICS.RPT_CUSTOMER_INVOICE_SALES
COMMENT='Synthetic prework report fixture; not a published business dashboard.'
AS
SELECT c.CUSTOMERID, c.CUSTOMERNAME, COUNT(DISTINCT i.INVOICEID) AS INVOICE_COUNT,
 SUM(l.EXTENDEDPRICE-l.TAXAMOUNT) AS SALES_EXCLUDING_TAX,
 SUM(l.TAXAMOUNT) AS TAX, SUM(l.EXTENDEDPRICE) AS TOTAL_INCLUDING_TAX
FROM HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.RAW.CUSTOMERS c
JOIN HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.RAW.INVOICES i ON i.CUSTOMERID=c.CUSTOMERID
JOIN HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.RAW.INVOICELINES l ON l.INVOICEID=i.INVOICEID
GROUP BY c.CUSTOMERID,c.CUSTOMERNAME;

Need versions; fetch full definitions.
I traced the visual through four links, from the Spotfire chart down to the raw table columns. Every step is backed by a source document. All of these documents are synthetic Northstar Supply fixtures, not real Spotfire or HANA exports.

**Lineage (all source-backed)**

| # | Edge | Evidence (doc_id · source_path · source_version) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Visual `SYN_VIZ_CUSTOMER` "Customer invoiced sales": value = `Sum([SalesAmount])`, category = `[CUSTOMERNAME]`, data table `InvoiceSales` | CONNECTED_a5086dc0ef985e23 · fixtures/spotfire/customer_sales.metadata.json · 46742043d0c70b3e9492aca16f0c3fc04404c1db0bc14e334978b2674f172357 |
| 2 | Calculated column `SalesAmount` = `[INVOICED_SALES_EX_TAX]`. `InvoiceSales` is loaded by `fixtures/spotfire/customer_sales.source.sql` | same as above |
| 3 | The source SQL selects `INVOICED_SALES_EX_TAX` and `CUSTOMERNAME` (plus `CUSTOMERID`, `INVOICEDATE` and other columns) from `"SYNTHETIC_SALES"."CV_INVOICE_SALES"` | CONNECTED_1055b17d75582621 · fixtures/spotfire/customer_sales.source.sql · f67352b5a51bba4566da228ea9c31326007138b0e8e05aabca4de2686370f561 |
| 4 | In model `CV_INVOICE_SALES` (one row per `INVOICELINEID`): `INVOICED_SALES_EX_TAX = INVOICELINES.EXTENDEDPRICE − INVOICELINES.TAXAMOUNT` and `CUSTOMERNAME = CUSTOMERS.CUSTOMERNAME`. The joins are all inner and many-to-one: `INVOICELINES.INVOICEID → INVOICES.INVOICEID`, `INVOICES.CUSTOMERID → CUSTOMERS.CUSTOMERID`, `INVOICELINES.STOCKITEMID → STOCKITEMS.STOCKITEMID` | CONNECTED_c321fb5572f5ed86 · fixtures/hana/CV_INVOICE_SALES.model.xml · d33d0ec9211725e359b399623b46396df45aca42fac9800473bebb08cc061ce3 |

**What the measure resolves to:** `SUM(INVOICELINES.EXTENDEDPRICE − INVOICELINES.TAXAMOUNT)`, grouped by `CUSTOMERS.CUSTOMERNAME`. It covers all loaded invoice dates, has no filters, and has no currency. This matches the business definition of invoiced sales: ExtendedPrice minus TaxAmount, on an invoice-date basis, because ExtendedPrice includes tax.

**Gaps and caveats**
- **Customer grouping:** the visual groups by `CUSTOMERNAME`, which is only a label. Customer identity is `CUSTOMERID`. Nothing in the documents says names are unique, so two customers with the same name could be summed together.
- **Physical schema:** the model lists bare table names (`INVOICELINES`, `INVOICES`, `CUSTOMERS`, `STOCKITEMS`) without saying which schema they live in. The separate "Customer invoiced sales" report fixture uses `HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.RAW.*`. That is a different report, so it doesn't prove the Spotfire path reads those same tables.
- **Unused join:** the model's inner join to `STOCKITEMS` isn't needed for this measure, but it would drop any invoice lines that have no matching stock item. I found no evidence on whether such lines exist.
- **Completeness:** I found these documents by ranked search, which can't prove nothing else exists. Other definitions, such as a HANA `.sql` version of `CV_INVOICE_SALES`, may exist and weren't reviewed.

I didn't propose, build, validate or release anything; this was a trace only.
